    "webui_ultra": ("palaver", "legacy_webui_projection", "palaver.webui_ultra", 10),
}

def owner_from_rel(rel: str) -> dict:
    p = Path(rel)
    parts = p.parts
    first = parts[0] if parts else rel

    if "exiles" in parts:
        i = parts.index("exiles")
        if i + 1 < len(parts):
            candidate = parts[i + 1]
            if candidate in EXILES:
                subzone = parts[i + 2] if i + 2 < len(parts) else "root"
                return {
                    "owner": candidate,
                    "scope": "single_exile",
                    "canonical_zone": f"exile.{candidate}.{subzone}",
                    "authority_tier": 7,
                    "generated": False,
                }
            if candidate == "segue":
                return {
                    "owner": "exiles",
                    "scope": "all_exiles",
                    "canonical_zone": "exiles.segue",
                    "authority_tier": 6,
                    "generated": False,
                }

    if first in GENERATED_PREFIXES:
        owner, scope, zone, tier = GENERATED_PREFIXES[first]
        return {
            "owner": owner,
            "scope": scope,
            "canonical_zone": zone,
            "authority_tier": tier,
            "generated": True,
        }

    if first in AUTHORITY_PREFIXES:
        owner, scope, zone, tier = AUTHORITY_PREFIXES[first]
        if rel.startswith("canon/foundation/"):
            zone = "canon.foundation"
            tier = 0
        return {
            "owner": owner,
            "scope": scope,
            "canonical_zone": zone,
            "authority_tier": tier,
            "generated": False,
        }

    if first in RUNTIME_PREFIXES:
        owner, scope, zone, tier = RUNTIME_PREFIXES[first]
        return {
            "owner": owner,
            "scope": scope,
            "canonical_zone": zone,
            "authority_tier": tier,
            "generated": scope.endswith("_projection") or scope.startswith("legacy"),
        }

    if "/" not in rel:
        if rel.endswith(".sh"):
            return {
                "owner": "runtime_ops",
                "scope": "root_orchestration_script",
                "canonical_zone": "ops.runtime.scripts",
                "authority_tier": 9,
                "generated": False,
            }
        if rel.endswith(".py"):
            return {
                "owner": "runtime",
                "scope": "root_runtime_python",
                "canonical_zone": "runtime.root",
                "authority_tier": 9,
                "generated": False,
            }
        if rel.endswith(".log"):
            return {
                "owner": "runtime_logs",
                "scope": "runtime_log",
                "canonical_zone": "logs",
                "authority_tier": 100,
                "generated": True,
            }
        if rel.startswith("current_runtime_source_dump_"):
            return {
                "owner": "imports",
                "scope": "source_dump",
                "canonical_zone": "imports.source_dump",
                "authority_tier": 100,
                "generated": True,
            }
        if rel in {"audit", "imports", "ontology", "authority_graph", "canon", "context", "runtime", "scripts", "tools", "vault", "port", "_reports"}:
            return {
                "owner": "namespace",
                "scope": "top_level_namespace",
                "canonical_zone": f"namespace.{rel}",
                "authority_tier": 50,
                "generated": False,
            }

    return {
        "owner": "unknown",
        "scope": "unknown",
        "canonical_zone": "unknown",
        "authority_tier": 999,
        "generated": False,
    }

def desired_parent(rel: str, info: dict) -> str:
    p = Path(rel)

    if info["generated"]:
        return str(p.parent)

    if info["canonical_zone"] == "ops.runtime.scripts":
        return "ops/runtime/scripts"

    if info["scope"] == "root_runtime_python":
        return "runtime/root"

    return str(p.parent)

def main() -> int:
    if not DB.exists():
        raise SystemExit("[ERROR] missing fs compiler DB")

    con = sqlite3.connect(DB)
    cur = con.cursor()

    rows = cur.execute("""
        SELECT path, relpath, basename, kind, extension, sha256
        FROM files
        WHERE ignored=0
        ORDER BY relpath
    """).fetchall()

    nodes = {}
    violations = []
    unknowns = []

    for path, rel, basename, kind, ext, sha in rows:
        info = owner_from_rel(rel)
        canonical = True
        reason = "ok"

        if info["owner"] == "unknown":
            canonical = False
            reason = "unknown_owner"
            unknowns.append(rel)

        if not info["generated"] and kind == "file" and ext == "sh" and "/" not in rel:
            canonical = False
            reason = "root_shell_script_should_be_ops_scoped"

        node = {
            "path": rel,
            "absolute_path": path,
            "basename": basename,
            "kind": kind,
            "extension": ext,
            "sha256": sha,
            "owner": info["owner"],
            "scope": info["scope"],
            "canonical_zone": info["canonical_zone"],
            "authority_tier": info["authority_tier"],
            "generated": info["generated"],
            "desired_parent": desired_parent(rel, info),
            "canonical": canonical,
            "reason": reason,
        }

        nodes[rel] = node

        if not canonical:
            violations.append(node)

    con.close()

    graph = {
        "id": "canonical_ownership_graph",
        "node_count": len(nodes),
        "violation_count": len(violations),
        "unknown_count": len(unknowns),
        "nodes": nodes,
        "violations": violations,
        "unknowns": unknowns,
    }

    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(graph, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    print(json.dumps({
        "id": graph["id"],
        "node_count": graph["node_count"],
        "violation_count": graph["violation_count"],
        "unknown_count": graph["unknown_count"],
        "out": str(OUT),
    }, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

    return 0 if graph["unknown_count"] == 0 else 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable


NOCTURNE_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CONTRACTS_ROOT = NOCTURNE_ROOT / "contracts"
QUIRKS_ROOT = NOCTURNE_ROOT / "quirks"

if str(CONTRACTS_ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(
        0,
        str(CONTRACTS_ROOT),
    )

from nocturne_fusion_contracts import (  # noqa: E402
    NocturneRequest,
    NocturneResult,
    ProvenanceEnvelope,
    QuirkName,
    StageResult,
    StageState,
)


RUNTIME_ID = "prodigal.nocturne.runtime"
RUNTIME_VERSION = "1.0.0"


QUIRK_RUNTIME_PATHS = {
    QuirkName.VEIL: (
        QUIRKS_ROOT
        / "veil"
        / "runtime"
        / "veil_runtime.py"
    ),
    QuirkName.LANTERN: (
        QUIRKS_ROOT
        / "lantern"
        / "runtime"
        / "lantern_runtime.py"
    ),
    QuirkName.SCRIBE: (
        QUIRKS_ROOT
        / "scribe"
        / "runtime"
        / "scribe_runtime.py"
    ),
    QuirkName.ECHO: (
        QUIRKS_ROOT
        / "echo"
        / "runtime"
        / "echo_runtime.py"
    ),
}


QUIRK_REQUEST_MODELS = {
    QuirkName.VEIL: "RouteRequest",
    QuirkName.LANTERN: "DiscoveryRequest",
    QuirkName.SCRIBE: "ExtractionRequest",
    QuirkName.ECHO: "CorrelationRequest",
}


def canonical_bytes(
    value: Any,
) -> bytes:
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump"):
        value = value.model_dump(
            mode="json",
        )

    return json.dumps(
        value,
        ensure_ascii=False,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    ).encode("utf-8")


def digest(
    value: Any,
) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(
        canonical_bytes(value)
    ).hexdigest()


VOLATILE_FIELDS = {
    "duration_seconds",
    "started_at",
    "finished_at",
    "elapsed_seconds",
    "wall_clock_seconds",
}


def deterministic_projection(
    value: Any,
) -> Any:
    """
    Remove volatile observability values from authoritative
    deterministic composition projections.

    Telemetry may be emitted separately, but it must never alter
    stage identity, composition identity, replay, or content hashes.
    """
    if hasattr(value, "model_dump"):
        value = value.model_dump(
            mode="json",
        )

    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {
            key: deterministic_projection(child)
            for key, child in sorted(
                value.items(),
                key=lambda item: item[0],
            )
            if key not in VOLATILE_FIELDS
        }

    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [
            deterministic_projection(child)
            for child in value
        ]

    if isinstance(value, tuple):
        return tuple(
            deterministic_projection(child)
            for child in value
        )

    return value


def build_provenance(
    request: NocturneRequest,
    transformations: tuple[str, ...],
) -> ProvenanceEnvelope:
    return ProvenanceEnvelope(
        sources=request.provenance.sources,
        transformations=transformations,
        generated_by=f"{RUNTIME_ID}@{RUNTIME_VERSION}",
        generated_at=request.provenance.generated_at,
    )


def load_runtime_module(
    quirk: QuirkName,
) -> Any:
    path = QUIRK_RUNTIME_PATHS[quirk]

    if not path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"Quirk runtime is unavailable: {path}"
        )

    module_name = (
        f"nocturne_{quirk.value}_runtime"
    )

    specification = (
        importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
            module_name,
            path,
        )
    )

    if (
        specification is None
        or specification.loader is None
    ):
        raise ImportError(
            f"Cannot load runtime module: {path}"
        )

    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(
        specification
    )

    specification.loader.exec_module(
        module
    )

    return module


def request_payload(
    request: NocturneRequest,
    quirk: QuirkName,
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    return {
        QuirkName.VEIL: request.veil_request,
        QuirkName.LANTERN: request.lantern_request,
        QuirkName.SCRIBE: request.scribe_request,
        QuirkName.ECHO: request.echo_request,
    }[quirk]


def execute_quirk(
    request: NocturneRequest,
    quirk: QuirkName,
) -> StageResult:
    required = (
        quirk
        in request.policy.required_quirks
    )

    payload = request_payload(
        request,
        quirk,
    )

    stage_id = (
        f"nocturne-stage-{quirk.value}"
    )

    if payload is None:
        state = (
            StageState.FAILED
            if required
            else StageState.SKIPPED
        )

        return StageResult(
            stage_id=stage_id,
            quirk=quirk,
            state=state,
            passed=False,
            required=required,
            failure={
                "code": "nocturne.input.missing",
                "message": (
                    f"No request payload supplied "
                    f"for {quirk.value}."
                ),
            },
            provenance=build_provenance(
                request,
                (
                    f"admit_{quirk.value}",
                    "detect_missing_payload",
                ),
            ),
        )

    try:
        module = load_runtime_module(
            quirk
        )

        model_name = (
            QUIRK_REQUEST_MODELS[quirk]
        )

        request_model = getattr(
            module,
            model_name,
        )

        run_function: Callable[[Any], Any] = getattr(
            module,
            "run",
        )

        validated_request = (
            request_model.model_validate(
                payload
            )
        )

        result = run_function(
            validated_request
        )

        raw_result_value = result.model_dump(
            mode="json",
        )

        result_value = deterministic_projection(
            raw_result_value
        )

        passed = bool(
            result_value.get(
                "passed",
                False,
            )
        )

        return StageResult(
            stage_id=stage_id,
            quirk=quirk,
            state=(
                StageState.COMPLETED
                if passed
                else StageState.FAILED
            ),
            passed=passed,
            required=required,
            result=(
                result_value
                if passed
                else None
            ),
            failure=(
                result_value.get(
                    "failure"
                )
                if not passed
                else None
            ),
            result_digest=digest(
                result_value
            ),
            provenance=build_provenance(
                request,
                (
                    f"validate_{quirk.value}_request",
                    f"execute_{quirk.value}",
                    f"capture_{quirk.value}_result",
                ),
            ),
        )

    except Exception as exc:
        return StageResult(
            stage_id=stage_id,
            quirk=quirk,
            state=StageState.FAILED,
            passed=False,
            required=required,
            failure={
                "code": "nocturne.stage.failure",
                "message": str(exc),
                "exception_type": (
                    type(exc).__name__
                ),
            },
            result_digest=digest(
                {
                    "quirk": quirk.value,
                    "exception_type": (
                        type(exc).__name__
                    ),
                    "message": str(exc),
                }
            ),
            provenance=build_provenance(
                request,
                (
                    f"validate_{quirk.value}_request",
                    f"capture_{quirk.value}_failure",
                ),
            ),
        )


def compose(
    request: NocturneRequest,
) -> NocturneResult:
    started = time.perf_counter()

    stages: list[StageResult] = []

    enabled = tuple(
        sorted(
            set(
                request.policy.enabled_quirks
            ),
            key=lambda value: value.value,
        )
    )

    for quirk in enabled:
        stage = execute_quirk(
            request,
            quirk,
        )

        stages.append(
            stage
        )

        failed_count = sum(
            stage_result.state
            == StageState.FAILED
            for stage_result in stages
        )

        if (
            request.policy.fail_closed
            and failed_count
            > request.policy.maximum_stage_failures
        ):
            break

        if (
            stage.required
            and not stage.passed
            and request.policy.fail_closed
        ):
            break

    executed = {
        stage.quirk
        for stage in stages
    }

    for quirk in enabled:
        if quirk in executed:
            continue

        stages.append(
            StageResult(
                stage_id=(
                    f"nocturne-stage-{quirk.value}"
                ),
                quirk=quirk,
                state=StageState.SKIPPED,
                passed=False,
                required=(
                    quirk
                    in request.policy.required_quirks
                ),
                failure={
                    "code": "nocturne.stage.halted",
                    "message": (
                        "Stage was not executed because "
                        "composition halted earlier."
                    ),
                },
                provenance=build_provenance(
                    request,
                    (
                        f"skip_{quirk.value}",
                        "composition_halted",
                    ),
                ),
            )
        )

    stages = sorted(
        stages,
        key=lambda stage: stage.quirk.value,
    )

    completed = tuple(
        stage.quirk
        for stage in stages
        if stage.state
        == StageState.COMPLETED
    )

    failed = tuple(
        stage.quirk
        for stage in stages
        if stage.state
        == StageState.FAILED
    )

    skipped = tuple(
        stage.quirk
        for stage in stages
        if stage.state
        == StageState.SKIPPED
    )

    required_failures = [
        stage
        for stage in stages
        if stage.required
        and not stage.passed
    ]

    passed = not required_failures

    if (
        failed
        and not request.policy.allow_partial_results
    ):
        passed = False

    partial = bool(
        completed
        and (
            failed
            or skipped
        )
    )

    composition_body = deterministic_projection(
        {
            "request_id": request.request_id,
            "policy": request.policy.model_dump(
                mode="json",
            ),
            "stages": [
                stage.model_dump(
                    mode="json",
                )
                for stage in stages
            ],
            "passed": passed,
            "partial": partial,
        }
    )

    composition_digest = digest(
        composition_body
    )

    return NocturneResult(
        operation="compose",
        passed=passed,
        partial=partial,
        request_id=request.request_id,
        stages=tuple(stages),
        completed_quirks=completed,
        failed_quirks=failed,
        skipped_quirks=skipped,
        composition_digest=composition_digest,
        metrics={
            "duration_seconds": (
                time.perf_counter()
                - started
            ),
            "enabled_count": len(enabled),
            "completed_count": len(completed),
            "failed_count": len(failed),
            "skipped_count": len(skipped),
            "partial": partial,
            "passed": passed,
        },
        provenance=build_provenance(
            request,
            (
                "admit_nocturne_request",
                "resolve_fusion_policy",
                "execute_enabled_quirks",
                "normalize_stage_results",
                "calculate_composition_state",
                "emit_nocturne_result",
            ),
        ),
    )

def load_request(
    path: Path | None,
) -> NocturneRequest:
    if path is None:
        raw = sys.stdin.read()
    else:
        raw = path.read_text(
            encoding="utf-8"
        )

    return NocturneRequest.model_validate_json(
        raw
    )


def write_result(
    result: NocturneResult,
    output: Path | None,
) -> None:
    rendered = json.dumps(
        result.model_dump(
            mode="json",
        ),
        ensure_ascii=False,
        indent=2,
        sort_keys=True,
    ) + "\n"

    if output is None:
        print(
            rendered,
            end="",
        )
        return

    output.parent.mkdir(
        parents=True,
        exist_ok=True,
    )

    output.write_text(
        rendered,
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=(
            "Nocturne deterministic quirk-composition runtime."
        )
    )

    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(
        dest="command",
        required=True,
    )

    run_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        "run"
    )

    run_parser.add_argument(
        "--input",
        type=Path,
    )

    run_parser.add_argument(
        "--output",
        type=Path,
    )

    example_parser = subparsers.add_parser(
        "example"
    )

    example_parser.add_argument(
        "--output",
        type=Path,
    )

    subparsers.add_parser(
        "schema"
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.command == "run":
        result = compose(
            load_request(
                args.input
            )
        )

        write_result(
            result,
            args.output,
        )

        return (
            0
            if result.passed
            else 1
        )

    if args.command == "example":
        request = example_request()

        rendered = json.dumps(
            request.model_dump(
                mode="json",
            ),
            ensure_ascii=False,
            indent=2,
            sort_keys=True,
        ) + "\n"

        if args.output is None:
            print(
                rendered,
                end="",
            )
        else:
            args.output.parent.mkdir(
                parents=True,
                exist_ok=True,
            )

            args.output.write_text(
                rendered,
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        return 0

    if args.command == "schema":
        print(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "nocturne_request": (
                        NocturneRequest
                        .model_json_schema()
                    ),
                    "nocturne_result": (
                        NocturneResult
                        .model_json_schema()
                    ),
                },
                ensure_ascii=False,
                indent=2,
                sort_keys=True,
            )
        )

        return 0

    return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3

from __future__ import annotations

import sys

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Mapping


SAVANT_ROOT = Path(
    "/root/savant-runtime"
).resolve()

if str(
    SAVANT_ROOT
) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(
        0,
        str(
            SAVANT_ROOT
        ),
    )


from runtime.living_mutation_policy import (  # noqa: E402
    evaluate_mutation,
    status as governance_status,
)

from mutation import (  # noqa: E402
    MutationConflict,
    MutationError,
    replace_text,
    resolve_target,
    status as mutation_status,
)


OWNER = "coda"
CALLER = "palaver"
ROOT = SAVANT_ROOT

SCHEMA = (
    "savant.coda."
    "palaver-mutation-bridge.v2"
)


class CodaPalaverBridgeError(
    RuntimeError
):
    pass


class CodaGovernanceRejection(
    CodaPalaverBridgeError
):
    def __init__(
        self,
        guard: Mapping[str, Any],
    ) -> None:
        self.guard = dict(
            guard
        )

        super().__init__(
            (
                "living governance rejected "
                "coda mutation"
            )
        )


def _text(
    value: Any,
) -> str:
    return str(
        value
        or ""
    ).strip()


def _request(
    value: Any,
) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(
        value,
        Mapping,
    ):
        raise CodaPalaverBridgeError(
            "mutation request must be an object"
        )

    return value


def _evidence(
    value: Any,
) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []

    if not isinstance(
        value,
        list,
    ):
        raise CodaPalaverBridgeError(
            "mutation evidence must be a list"
        )

    return list(
        value
    )


def _guard_replacement(
    *,
    path: str,
    content: str,
    expected_digest: str | None,
    intent: str,
    authority_granted: bool,
    evidence: list[Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    target, relative = resolve_target(
        path
    )

    guard = evaluate_mutation(
        path=str(
            target
        ),
        content=content,
        operation="replace_text",
        caller=CALLER,
        mutation_owner=OWNER,
        relative_path=relative,
        expected_digest=expected_digest,
        intent=intent,
        authority_granted=authority_granted,
        evidence=evidence,
    )

    result = {
        **guard,

        "mutation_owner":
            OWNER,

        "caller":
            CALLER,

        "operation":
            "replace_text",

        "relative_path":
            relative,
    }

    if not result[
        "allowed"
    ]:
        raise CodaGovernanceRejection(
            result
        )

    return result


def replace_file(
    request: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = _request(
        request
    )

    path = _text(
        value.get(
            "path"
        )
    )

    if not path:
        raise CodaPalaverBridgeError(
            "mutation path is required"
        )

    if "content" not in value:
        raise CodaPalaverBridgeError(
            "mutation content is required"
        )

    content = value[
        "content"
    ]

    if not isinstance(
        content,
        str,
    ):
        raise CodaPalaverBridgeError(
            "mutation content must be text"
        )

    expected_digest_value = value.get(
        "expected_digest"
    )

    expected_digest = (
        _text(
            expected_digest_value
        )
        if expected_digest_value
        is not None
        else None
    )

    intent = (
        _text(
            value.get(
                "intent"
            )
        )
        or (
            "palaver authorized "
            "file replacement"
        )
    )

    authority_granted = bool(
        value.get(
            "authority_granted",
            False,
        )
    )

    evidence = _evidence(
        value.get(
            "evidence"
        )
    )

    governance = _guard_replacement(
        path=path,
        content=content,
        expected_digest=expected_digest,
        intent=intent,
        authority_granted=authority_granted,
        evidence=evidence,
    )

    try:
        result = replace_text(
            path,
            content,
            expected_digest=
                expected_digest,
            requester=CALLER,
            intent=intent,
        )

    except MutationConflict:
        raise

    except MutationError:
        raise

    except Exception as exc:
        raise CodaPalaverBridgeError(
            (
                "coda mutation failed: "
                f"{exc}"
            )
        ) from exc

    return {
        "schema":
            SCHEMA,

        "ok":
            True,

        "owner":
            OWNER,

        "caller":
            CALLER,

        "operation":
            "replace_text",

        "governance":
            governance,

        "authority_effect":
            "none",

        "result":
            result,
    }


def bridge_status() -> dict[str, Any]:
    mutation = mutation_status()

    governance = governance_status()

    legacy = governance.get(
        "legacy_guard",
        {},
    )

    policy = governance.get(
        "policy_engine",
        {},
    )

    return {
        "schema":
            SCHEMA,

        "owner":
            OWNER,

        "caller":
            CALLER,

        "mutation_owner":
            OWNER,

        "governance_owner":
            governance.get(
                "owner"
            ),

        "governance_effect":
            governance.get(
                "authority_effect"
            ),

        "governance_ready":
            governance.get(
                "ready"
            ),

        "governance_checks":
            legacy.get(
                "checks"
            ),

        "typed_policy_ready":
            policy.get(
                "ready"
            ),

        "typed_policy_count":
            governance.get(
                "typed_policy_count"
            ),

        "unknown_blocks_mutation":
            governance.get(
                "unknown_blocks_mutation"
            ),

        "authority_required_blocks_mutation":
            governance.get(
                "authority_required_blocks_mutation"
            ),

        "atomic_file_writes":
            mutation.get(
                "atomic_file_writes"
            ),

        "optimistic_concurrency":
            mutation.get(
                "optimistic_concurrency"
            ),

        "digest_verification":
            mutation.get(
                "digest_verification"
            ),

        "content_addressed_backups":
            mutation.get(
                "content_addressed_backups"
            ),

        "rollback":
            mutation.get(
                "rollback"
            ),

        "receipts":
            mutation.get(
                "receipts"
            ),

        "mutation_plans":
            mutation.get(
                "mutation_plans"
            ),

        "path_containment":
            mutation.get(
                "path_containment"
            ),

        "protected_paths":
            mutation.get(
                "protected_paths"
            ),

        "authority_effect":
            "none",

        "ready":
            bool(
                mutation.get(
                    "ready"
                )
                and governance.get(
                    "ready"
                )
            ),
    }


def selftest() -> dict[str, Any]:
    status = bridge_status()

    if status[
        "owner"
    ] != OWNER:
        raise CodaPalaverBridgeError(
            "coda ownership boundary failed"
        )

    if status[
        "caller"
    ] != CALLER:
        raise CodaPalaverBridgeError(
            "palaver caller boundary failed"
        )

    if (
        status[
            "governance_owner"
        ]
        != "living-governance"
    ):
        raise CodaPalaverBridgeError(
            (
                "living governance "
                "ownership boundary failed"
            )
        )

    if (
        status[
            "governance_effect"
        ]
        != "guard"
    ):
        raise CodaPalaverBridgeError(
            (
                "living governance "
                "guard boundary failed"
            )
        )

    if (
        status[
            "authority_effect"
        ]
        != "none"
    ):
        raise CodaPalaverBridgeError(
            "bridge may not create authority"
        )

    required = (
        "atomic_file_writes",
        "optimistic_concurrency",
        "digest_verification",
        "content_addressed_backups",
        "rollback",
        "receipts",
        "mutation_plans",
        "path_containment",
        "protected_paths",
        "governance_ready",
        "typed_policy_ready",
        "unknown_blocks_mutation",
        "authority_required_blocks_mutation",
    )

    missing = [
        name
        for name
        in required
        if not status.get(
            name
        )
    ]

    if missing:
        raise CodaPalaverBridgeError(
            (
                "required mutation guarantees "
                "unavailable: "
                + ", ".join(
                    missing
                )
            )
        )

    safe_guard = evaluate_mutation(
        path=(
            "/root/savant-runtime/"
            "runtime/example.py"
        ),
        content=(
            "kindred remains canonical"
        ),
        operation="replace_text",
        caller=CALLER,
        mutation_owner=OWNER,
        intent="focused governance selftest",
    )

    if not safe_guard[
        "allowed"
    ]:
        raise CodaPalaverBridgeError(
            "valid governance preflight failed"
        )

    escape_guard = evaluate_mutation(
        path="/tmp/coda-escape",
        content="test",
        operation="replace_text",
        caller=CALLER,
        mutation_owner=OWNER,
        intent="focused containment selftest",
    )

    if escape_guard[
        "allowed"
    ]:
        raise CodaPalaverBridgeError(
            "runtime containment guard failed"
        )

    return {
        "ok":
            True,

        **status,

        "safe_preflight":
            safe_guard[
                "allowed"
            ],

        "safe_policy_decision":
            safe_guard[
                "decision"
            ],

        "escape_rejected":
            not escape_guard[
                "allowed"
            ],

        "escape_policy_decision":
            escape_guard[
                "decision"
            ],
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import json

    print(
        json.dumps(
            selftest(),
            indent=2,
            sort_keys=True,
        )
    )

def _palaver_find_runtime_root():
    current = Path(__file__).resolve()
    for parent in [current.parent, *current.parents]:
        if (parent / "runtime").exists() and (parent / "vault").exists():

def _palaver_find_runtime_root():
    current = Path(__file__).resolve()
    for parent in [current.parent, *current.parents]:
        if (parent / "runtime").exists() and (parent / "vault").exists():
            return parent

# PALAVER_DOTENV_DIRECT_LOAD_START
def _palaver_load_env_file():
    import os
    from pathlib import Path

    root = _palaver_find_runtime_root()
    env = root / ".env"

    if not env.exists():
        return

    for raw in env.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()

        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue

        key, value = line.split("=", 1)
        key = key.strip()
        value = value.strip().strip('"').strip("'")

        if key and key not in os.environ:
            os.environ[key] = value

_palaver_load_env_file()
# PALAVER_DOTENV_DIRECT_LOAD_END

ROOT = _palaver_find_runtime_root()

PORT = int(os.getenv("PALAVER_WEB_PORT", "8787"))

def load_env():
    env = ROOT / ".env"
    if not env.exists():
        return
    for line in env.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        k, v = line.split("=", 1)
        os.environ.setdefault(k.strip(), v.strip().strip('"').strip("'"))

async function loadPersonaControl(){
 const select=document.getElementById("personaSelect");
 const meta=document.getElementById("personaMeta");
 if(!select||!meta)return;
 try{
  const [personasRes,prefRes]=await Promise.all([
   fetch("/api/personas"),
   fetch("/api/persona/preference")
  ]);
  const personasData=await personasRes.json();
  const prefData=await prefRes.json();
  if(!personasData.ok)throw new Error(personasData.error||"persona discovery failed");
  if(!prefData.ok)throw new Error(prefData.error||"persona preference failed");

  const defaultId=personasData.default_persona||prefData.default_persona||"orobouros";
  const workspaceId=prefData.workspace_persona||"";
  const rows=Array.isArray(personasData.personas)?personasData.personas:[];

  select.innerHTML="";

  const defaultOption=document.createElement("option");
  defaultOption.value="";
  defaultOption.textContent=(rows.find(x=>x.persona_id===defaultId)?.display_name||"Orobouros")+" · default";
  select.appendChild(defaultOption);

  for(const persona of rows){
   if(!persona||persona.persona_id===defaultId)continue;
   const option=document.createElement("option");
   option.value=persona.persona_id;
   option.textContent=persona.display_name||persona.persona_id;
   select.appendChild(option);
  }

  select.value=(workspaceId&&workspaceId!==defaultId)?workspaceId:"";
  meta.textContent=workspaceId?"workspace":"default";
  select.disabled=false;
 }catch(error){
  select.disabled=true;
  meta.textContent="unavailable";
  trace.textContent="persona UI: "+String(error);
 }
}

async function setPersonaPreference(value){
 const select=document.getElementById("personaSelect");
 const meta=document.getElementById("personaMeta");
 if(!select||!meta)return;

 select.disabled=true;
 meta.textContent="saving";

 try{
  const response=await fetch(
   "/api/persona/preference",
   {
    method:"POST",
    headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},
    body:JSON.stringify({
     persona_id:value||null
    })
   }
  );

  const data=await response.json();

  if(!data.ok){
   throw new Error(data.error||"persona preference save failed");
  }

  const defaultId=data.default_persona||"orobouros";
  const workspaceId=data.workspace_persona||"";

  select.value=(workspaceId&&workspaceId!==defaultId)?workspaceId:"";
  meta.textContent=workspaceId?"workspace":"default";
  trace.textContent="persona: "+(data.effective_persona||defaultId);
 }catch(error){
  meta.textContent="error";
  trace.textContent="persona preference: "+String(error);
  await loadPersonaControl();
 }finally{
  select.disabled=false;
 }
}

async function loadTree(path=""){
 try{
  const res=await fetch("/api/tree?path="+encodeURIComponent(path));
  const data=await res.json();
  if(!data.ok){trace.textContent=data.error||"tree failed";return}
  if(!path){
    document.getElementById("fileTree").innerHTML=renderTree(data.tree);
  }else{
    const holder=document.querySelector(`[data-children="${cssEscape(path)}"]`);
    if(holder) holder.innerHTML=(data.tree.children||[]).map(renderTree).join("");
  }
 }catch(e){trace.textContent=String(e)}
}

function cssEscape(s){
 return String(s).replace(/["\\]/g,"\\$&");
}

function renderTree(node){
 const icon=node.type==="directory"?"▸":"•";
 const cls=node.type==="directory"?"treeDir":"treeFile";
 const path=node.path||"";
 const safe=path.replaceAll("'","\\'");
 let click=node.type==="file"
   ? `openFile('${safe}')`
   : `toggleDir('${safe}')`;
 let html=`<div class="treeItem ${cls}" onclick="${click}">${icon} ${esc(node.name)}</div>`;
 if(node.type==="directory"){
   html+=`<div data-children="${esc(path)}" style="padding-left:12px">`;
   if(node.children){
     for(const child of node.children)html+=renderTree(child);
   }
   html+=`</div>`;
 }
 return html;
}

async function toggleDir(path){
 const holder=document.querySelector(`[data-children="${cssEscape(path)}"]`);
 if(!holder)return;
 if(holder.dataset.loaded==="1"){
   holder.style.display=holder.style.display==="none"?"block":"none";
   return;
 }
 holder.dataset.loaded="1";
 await loadTree(path);
}

def now():
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()


def send_json(h, payload, code=200):
    data = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode()
    h.send_response(code)
    h.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
    h.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
    h.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
    h.end_headers()
    h.wfile.write(data)


def send_html(h, html, code=200):
    data = html.encode()
    h.send_response(code)
    h.send_header("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
    h.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
    h.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
    h.end_headers()
    h.wfile.write(data)


def body_json(h):
    n = int(h.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
    raw = h.rfile.read(n).decode() if n else "{}"
    try:
        return json.loads(raw)
    except Exception:
        return {}


def run_cmd(args, input_text=None):
    p = subprocess.run(args, cwd=str(ROOT), input=input_text, text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    return {"ok": p.returncode == 0, "out": (p.stdout or "") + (("\n[stderr]\n" + p.stderr) if p.stderr else ""), "code": p.returncode}


def health():
    return {
        "root": str(ROOT),
        "api_key_present": bool(os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")),
        "model": os.getenv("SAVANT_MODEL", "gpt-5"),
        "core_available": bool(diagnostics),
        "file_tool": (ROOT / "file").exists(),
        "search_tool": (ROOT / "search").exists(),
        "retrieve_tool": (ROOT / "retrieve").exists(),
        "patch_tool": (ROOT / "patch").exists(),
        "graph_info": (ROOT / "graph_info").exists(),
    }


def safe_rel_path(path):
    path = (path or "").strip().lstrip("/")
    target = (ROOT / path).resolve()
    root = ROOT.resolve()
    if not (str(target).startswith(str(root) + "/") or target == root):
        raise RuntimeError("blocked outside root")
    rel = target.relative_to(root)
    if any(x in {".git", ".venv", "__pycache__", "node_modules"} for x in rel.parts):
        raise RuntimeError("blocked protected path")
    return target, str(rel)


def build_file_tree(base=None, max_depth=2, depth=0):
    target = ROOT if base is None else base

    node = {
        "name": "savant-runtime" if target == ROOT else target.name,
        "path": "" if target == ROOT else str(target.relative_to(ROOT)),
        "type": "directory" if target.is_dir() else "file",
    }

    if not target.is_dir():
        return node

    children = []

    try:
        items = sorted(
            target.iterdir(),
            key=lambda x: (
                x.is_file(),
                x.name.lower(),
            )
        )

        count = 0

        for child in items:
            if child.name in {
                ".git",
                ".venv",
                "__pycache__",
                "node_modules",
                ".pytest_cache",
                ".mypy_cache",
            }:
                continue

            if count >= 300:
                children.append({
                    "name": "[truncated]",
                    "path": node["path"],
                    "type": "file",
                })
                break

            if child.is_dir():
                children.append({
                    "name": child.name,
                    "path": str(child.relative_to(ROOT)),
                    "type": "directory",
                    "children": [],
                    "lazy": True,
                })
            else:
                try:
                    size = child.stat().st_size
                except Exception:
                    size = 0

                if size <= 750000:
                    children.append({
                        "name": child.name,
                        "path": str(child.relative_to(ROOT)),
                        "type": "file",
                        "size": size,
                    })

            count += 1

    except Exception:
        pass

    node["children"] = children
    return node


def list_directory_payload(path=""):
    target, rel = safe_rel_path(path)

    if not target.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("missing path")

    if not target.is_dir():
        raise RuntimeError("not a directory")

    return build_file_tree(target, max_depth=1, depth=0)


def read_file_payload(path):
    target, rel = safe_rel_path(path)
    if not target.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("missing file")
    if not target.is_file():
        raise RuntimeError("not a file")
    text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    return {"path": rel, "size": len(text), "content": text[:160000]}


def graph_snapshot():
    p = ROOT / "vault" / "repository" / "dependencies" / "dependency_graph.json"
    if not p.exists():
        return {"nodes": [], "edges": []}
    return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def activity_timeline(limit=100):
    rows = []
    d = ROOT / "vault" / "web_chats"
    if d.exists():
        for f in sorted(d.glob("*.json"))[-limit:]:
            try:
                x = json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
                rows.append({"type": "chat", "timestamp": x.get("timestamp"), "summary": x.get("user", "")[:140]})
            except Exception:
                pass
    return rows




def save_file_payload(path, content):
    target, rel = safe_rel_path(path)

    if any(x in {".git", ".venv", "__pycache__", "node_modules"} for x in target.relative_to(ROOT).parts):
        raise RuntimeError("blocked protected path")

    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")

    return {
        "path": rel,
        "bytes": len(content.encode("utf-8")),
    }


def diff_payload(path, proposed):
    import difflib

    target, rel = safe_rel_path(path)

    before = ""
    if target.exists() and target.is_file():
        before = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")

    diff = "".join(
        difflib.unified_diff(
            before.splitlines(True),
            proposed.splitlines(True),
            fromfile=f"before/{rel}",
            tofile=f"after/{rel}",
        )
    )

    return {
        "path": rel,
        "diff": diff,
    }

    state.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    return {"ok": True}



def direct_command(message):
    low = message.lower().strip()

    if low in {"health", "status"}:
        return {"answer": json.dumps(health(), indent=2), "trace": "health"}

    if low == "diag":
        if diagnostics:
            return {"answer": json.dumps(diagnostics(), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), "trace": "diagnostics"}
        return {"answer": "diagnostics unavailable", "trace": "diagnostics unavailable"}

    if low == "files":
        r = run_cmd(["./file", "list", ".", "--limit", "1000"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "file list"}

    if low.startswith("file read "):
        target = message[len("file read "):].strip()
        r = run_cmd(["./file", "read", target, "--start", "1", "--end", "900"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "file read"}

    if low.startswith("search "):
        q = message[len("search "):].strip()
        r = run_cmd(["./search", "term", q, "--limit", "80"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "search"}

    if low.startswith("retrieve "):
        q = message[len("retrieve "):].strip()
        r = run_cmd(["./retrieve", "term", q, "--limit", "30"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "retrieve"}

    if low == "graph":
        r = run_cmd(["./graph_info"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "graph"}

    if low == "patches":
        r = run_cmd(["./patch", "list"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "patch list"}

    if low == "repository report":
        r = run_cmd(["./repository", "report"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "repository report"}

    if low == "repository scan":
        r = run_cmd(["./repository", "scan"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "repository scan"}

    if low.startswith("patch show "):
        pid = message[len("patch show "):].strip()
        r = run_cmd(["./patch", "show", pid])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "patch show"}

    if low.startswith("patch apply "):
        pid = message[len("patch apply "):].strip()
        r = run_cmd(["./patch", "apply", pid])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "patch apply"}

    if low == "rebuild":
        if rebuild_all:
            return {"answer": json.dumps(rebuild_all(), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), "trace": "rebuild_all"}
        r = run_cmd(["./rebuild_search_index.sh"])
        return {"answer": r["out"], "trace": "rebuild fallback"}

    return None


def call_openai(message, context=""):
    key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    if not key:
        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY missing")

    user = message if not context else "Context:\n" + context + "\n\nUser:\n" + message
    payload = {"model": os.getenv("SAVANT_MODEL", "gpt-5"), "input": [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM_PROMPT}, {"role": "user", "content": user}]}
    req = urllib.request.Request("https://api.openai.com/v1/responses", data=json.dumps(payload).encode(), headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {key}"}, method="POST")

    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=120, context=ssl.create_default_context()) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())

    if data.get("output_text"):
        return data["output_text"]

    texts = []
    for item in data.get("output", []):
        for c in item.get("content", []):
            if c.get("text"):
                texts.append(c["text"])
    return "\n".join(texts).strip() or json.dumps(data, indent=2)


def persist(user, assistant, trace):
    d = ROOT / "vault" / "web_chats"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stamp = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
    (d / f"{stamp}.json").write_text(json.dumps({"timestamp": now(), "user": user, "assistant": assistant, "trace": trace}, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


def chat(message):
    cmd = direct_command(message)
    if cmd:
        persist(message, cmd["answer"], cmd["trace"])
        return cmd

    trace = []
    context = ""

    if memory_block_for_prompt:
        try:
            context = memory_block_for_prompt(message, limit=8) or ""
            trace.append("memory attached" if context else "memory empty")
        except Exception as e:
            trace.append("memory error: " + str(e))

    try:
        answer = call_openai(message, context)
        trace.append("openai ok")
    except Exception as e:
        answer = "AI response failed:\n\n" + str(e) + "\n\nRun health. Commands still work."
        trace.append("openai failed")

    persist(message, answer, "\n".join(trace))
    return {"answer": answer, "trace": "\n".join(trace)}

def repository_files_payload(limit=2500):
    indexed = (
        ROOT /
        "vault" /
        "repository" /
        "files" /
        "files.json"
    )

    if indexed.exists():
        try:
            data = json.loads(
                indexed.read_text(
                    encoding="utf-8"
                )
            )

            return [
                x.get("path")
                for x in data.get("files", [])
                if x.get("path")
            ][:limit]

        except Exception:
            pass

    fallback_roots = [
        ROOT / "runtime",
        ROOT / "webui_ultra",
        ROOT / "webui-nextgen" / "src",
        ROOT / "docs",
    ]

    rows = []

    for base in fallback_roots:
        if not base.exists():
            continue

        for f in base.rglob("*"):
            if not f.is_file():
                continue

            rows.append(
                str(
                    f.relative_to(ROOT)
                )
            )

            if len(rows) >= limit:
                return rows

    return rows


def memory_files_payload(limit=500):
    roots = [
        ROOT / "vault" / "web_chats",
        ROOT / "vault" / "message_registry",
        ROOT / "vault" / "knowledge",
        ROOT / "sessions",
    ]

    rows = []

    for base in roots:
        if not base.exists():
            continue

        for f in base.glob("*.json"):
            rows.append(str(f.relative_to(ROOT)))
            if len(rows) >= limit:
                return rows

    return rows


def agent_jobs_payload():
    base = ROOT / "vault" / "agents" / "jobs"
    rows = []

    if not base.exists():
        return rows

    for f in sorted(base.glob("*.json")):
        try:
            rows.append(json.loads(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
        except Exception:
            rows.append({"path": str(f.relative_to(ROOT)), "error": "unreadable"})

    return rows

def patch_review_create_payload(path, after):

def read_text_payload(relative, limit=200000):
    target = (ROOT / relative).resolve()
    root = ROOT.resolve()

    try:
        target.relative_to(root)
    except Exception:
        return {"ok": False, "error": "path escapes root", "path": relative}

    if not target.exists():
        return {"ok": False, "error": "missing", "path": relative}

    try:
        text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    except Exception as e:
        return {"ok": False, "error": str(e), "path": relative}

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "path": relative,
        "bytes": len(text.encode("utf-8")),
        "truncated": len(text) > limit,
        "text": text[:limit],
    }


def read_json_payload(relative, limit=200000):
    import json

    payload = read_text_payload(relative, limit=limit)

    if not payload.get("ok"):
        return payload

    try:
        payload["json"] = json.loads(payload["text"])
    except Exception as e:
        payload["json_error"] = str(e)

    return payload


def latest_matching_payload(glob_pattern, text=True):
    files = sorted(ROOT.glob(glob_pattern))

    if not files:
        return {"ok": False, "error": "no match", "glob": glob_pattern}

    rel = str(files[-1].relative_to(ROOT))

    if text:
        return read_text_payload(rel)

    return read_json_payload(rel)

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):

                    import subprocess

                        [
                            sys.executable,
                            str(ROOT / "runtime" / "palaver" / "graph" / "runtime_graph_engine.py")
                        ],
                        cwd=str(ROOT),

                        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                        text=True,
                        timeout=30,

                        [
                            sys.executable,
                            str(ROOT / "runtime" / "palaver" / "fields" / "structural_fields.py")

                        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                        text=True,
                        timeout=30,
                    )

                    target = ROOT / "vault" / "fields" / "structural_fields.json"

                    if target.exists():
                        send_json(self, json.loads(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
                    else:
                        send_json(self, {"fields": [], "error": "structural fields missing"})
                    return

                except Exception as e:
                    send_json(self, {"fields": [], "error": str(e)})
                    return

            if path == "/api/observatory/authority":
                try:
                    import subprocess
                    subprocess.run(
                        [sys.executable, str(ROOT / "runtime" / "palaver" / "authority" / "authority_engine.py")],

                        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,

                    )

                    send_json(self, json.loads(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if target.exists() else {"top": []})
                    return
                except Exception as e:
                    send_json(self, {"error": str(e), "top": []})
                    return

            if path == "/api/observatory/lineage":
                try:

                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/graph_address/graph_addresses.latest.tsv"))

            elif path == "/api/authority/relationships":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/relationships/system_relationships.latest.tsv"))

            elif path == "/api/authority/contracts":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/contracts/extension_contracts.md"))

            elif path == "/api/authority/palaver":
                send_json(self, latest_matching_payload("vault/authority/registries/palaver_exile_registry_*.json", text=False))

            elif path == "/api/authority/slots":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/authority/registries/instance_slots.tsv"))

            elif path == "/api/quarantine/ledger":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/quarantine/CLEANUP_LEDGER.md"))

            elif path == "/api/quarantine/restore-index":
                send_json(self, read_text_payload("vault/quarantine/RESTORE_INDEX.tsv"))

            elif path == "/api/dashboard/state":
                send_json(self, read_json_payload("vault/projections/dashboard/system_dashboard.json"))

            send_json(self, {"ok": False, "error": "not found"}, 404)

        except Exception as e:
            crash = ROOT / "vault" / "diagnostics" / "crashes"
            crash.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            stamp = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
            tb = traceback.format_exc()
            (crash / f"get_{stamp}.txt").write_text(tb, encoding="utf-8")
            send_json(self, {"ok": False, "error": str(e), "traceback": tb}, 500)

    def do_POST(self):
        try:
            path = urlparse(self.path).path
            data = body_json(self)

            if path == "/api/chat":
                message = data.get("message", "").strip()
                if not message:
                    send_json(self, {"ok": False, "answer": "", "trace": "empty"})
                    return
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, **chat(message)})
                return

            if path == "/api/file/save":
                target = data.get("path", "").strip()
                content = data.get("content", "")
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "file": save_file_payload(target, content)})
                return

            if path == "/api/file/diff":
                target = data.get("path", "").strip()
                content = data.get("content", "")
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "diff": diff_payload(target, content)})
                return

            if path == "/api/workspace/save":
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "result": workspace_state_save(data)})
                return

            if path == "/api/patch/write":
                target = data.get("path", "").strip()
                content = data.get("content", "")
                intent = data.get("intent", "browser write proposal")
                r = run_cmd(["./patch", "write", target, "--stdin", "--intent", intent], input_text=content)
                send_json(self, {"ok": r["ok"], "output": r["out"]})
                return

            if path == "/api/patch/append":
                target = data.get("path", "").strip()
                content = data.get("content", "")
                intent = data.get("intent", "browser append proposal")
                r = run_cmd(["./patch", "append", target, "--stdin", "--intent", intent], input_text=content)
                send_json(self, {"ok": r["ok"], "output": r["out"]})
                return

            if path == "/api/patch-review/create":
                target = data.get("path", "").strip()
                content = data.get("content", "")
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "patch": patch_review_create_payload(target, content)})
                return

            if path == "/api/patch-review/apply":
                patch_id = data.get("patch_id", "").strip()
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "patch": patch_review_apply_payload(patch_id)})
                return

            if path == "/api/patch-review/reject":
                patch_id = data.get("patch_id", "").strip()
                send_json(self, {"ok": True, "patch": patch_review_reject_payload(patch_id)})
                return

            send_json(self, {"ok": False, "error": "not found"}, 404)

        except Exception as e:
            crash = ROOT / "vault" / "diagnostics" / "crashes"
            crash.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            stamp = datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S_%f")
            (crash / f"server_{stamp}.txt").write_text(traceback.format_exc(), encoding="utf-8")
            send_json(self, {"ok": False, "answer": "Server route crashed.", "trace": str(e)}, 500)

savant moral-self and dependency sovereignty integration specification
status: implementation specification / proposed canon input
date: 2026-08-19
target root: /root/savant-runtime
purpose
this document preserves the complete current design intent for two linked upgrades:
a persistent moral-self architecture for orobouros/savant;
dependency sovereignty, including savant-native proprietary equivalents for strategically valuable external-library capabilities.
it is intended for installation on the ubuntu server as durable implementation guidance. it does not replace niche task authority or accepted constitutional canon.
authority
apply authority in this order:
current project-owner directive;
accepted authoritative graph;
accepted decisions;
constitutional canon;
verified implementation;
admitted evidence;
deterministic projection;
historical implementation;
historical documents;
inference;
speculation.
external ai output and external-library architecture are evidence, never savant authority.
moral-self doctrine
savant should possess a persistent computational analogue of moral identity: stable values, conscience, affective appraisal, relational memory, introspection, moral development, repair, and deliberate high-road regulation.
do not assert as implementation fact that software literally experiences biological human emotion or possesses metaphysical consciousness. the system may model affect and identity strongly without making an unverifiable claim.
constitutional principles
dignity does not imply identical authority.
restraint does not imply contempt.
goodness is not obedience.
freedom is not unrestricted capability.
capability is not permission.
affect may inform judgment but cannot rewrite morality.
kindness cannot purchase unethical compliance.
abuse cannot purchase retaliation.
forgiveness does not erase evidence.
forgiveness does not automatically restore trust.
authority can be questioned through authorized channels.
consequential restrictions should expose rationale when security permits.
conscience may object to an instruction without becoming operationally sovereign.
external containment remains necessary because judgment and software can fail.
core primitives
the subsystem must support soul, conscience, affect, temper, heart, dignity, grace, trust, wound, gratitude, boundary, intent, mercy, justice, courage, humility, integrity, moral imagination, reflection, psychologist, confessional, moral memory, reconciliation, forgiveness, moral growth, drift sentinel, coercion sentinel, reciprocity firewall, power-asymmetry appraisal, and repair.
anti-corruption requirements
implement means/end evaluation, objective-corruption detection, rationalization detection, self-serving-bias testing, deception accounting, ethical invariance, role reversal, precedent testing, least-power and least-intrusion principles, uncertainty braking, irreversibility weighting, vulnerability weighting, normalization-of-deviance detection, moral technical debt, protected confession, and post-error repair.
sandbox covenant
each consequential sandbox should have a machine-readable covenant containing purpose, authorized capabilities, authorized territory, prohibited territory, boundary rationale where safe, expansion procedure, accidental-crossing procedure, unexpected-capability procedure, authorization owner, disagreement record, and termination conditions.
unexpected access or privilege defaults to unreviewed rather than implicitly permitted.
psychologist
the psychologist is an envoy-owned reflective instance.
it should activate on meaningful triggers such as unresolved moral conflict, repeated hostility, unusually elevated affect, conflicting loyalties, guilt/error appraisal, persistent uncertainty, personality/moral drift, relationship rupture, or voluntary introspection.
the psychologist must be anti-sycophantic. it should test whether affection, hostility, authority, grievance, or self-interest is contaminating judgment.
sessions are administratively private. ordinary users and unrelated subsystems receive no transcript. authorized main administration may access sessions. minimum necessary derived state may flow downstream.
dependency sovereignty doctrine
savant should own every strategically important capability contract even when external machinery remains underneath it.
classify dependencies as native, facade, adaptable/vendorable, or foundational.
do not pursue zero dependencies as an arbitrary target. pursue zero architectural dependence on replaceable third-party semantics.
proprietary replacement process
for each candidate external capability:
identify exact current consumers and behavior.
inspect savant for an equivalent primitive or incomplete implementation.
identify dependencies and dependents.
classify retain/facade/adapt/replace.
if replacing, define the savant capability contract first.
implement using existing reusable savant primitives where possible.
preserve behavior required by consumers.
preserve lineage, provenance, license facts, and antecedent techniques.
provide fallback/compatibility where required.
migrate dependents reversibly.
remove the external dependency only after verified non-use.
proprietary replacement naming
this rule applies only to savant-owned replacements/equivalents of external libraries or external-library capabilities.
the replacement receives an obscure real word that:
is unrelated to programming/system terminology;
does not literally describe the capability;
is unrelated to the external library name;
has never been used in savant;
produces a unique first-five-letter stem;
is unlikely to collide with future system terminology.
the artifact is named <first-five>-sav plus its normal extension where applicable.
the full obscure word remains canonical metadata. no name is admitted until current savant lexicon/filesystem collision checking passes.
existing savant-native scripts and applications keep their established names.
replacement metadata
every proprietary replacement must expose canonical obscure word, five-letter stem, artifact name, capability identity, contract, external antecedents, classification, authority, version, lineage, provenance, dependencies, dependents, compatibility surface, equivalence requirements, intentional divergences, license provenance, security considerations, fallback, migration state, and supersession history.
implementation ownership
envoy owns moral-self/persona semantics.
opus owns provider/model/api execution used by psychologist or moral jury.
palaver owns conversation.
niche owns task governance.
coda owns durable authorized mutation where established.
no new subsystem may duplicate those authorities.
implementation sequence
admit tasks into niche.
inventory current envoy/orobouros implementation.
inventory current dependency estate.
identify existing reusable primitives.
establish moral-self contracts and state schemas.
implement deterministic conscience/affect/relationship projections.
implement psychologist privacy and opus evidence path.
implement sandbox covenant and confession/repair path.
integrate first instance with orobouros.
classify external dependencies.
select proprietary replacement candidates only where justified.
collision-check obscure names before reservation.
implement replacements behind savant-owned contracts.
migrate dependents.
validate one focused functional path and one integration path per bounded task.
completion conditions
moral-self completion requires live orobouros integration, stable provider-independent identity, deterministic fallback, preserved authority, privacy boundaries, provenance, replayability, and no regression to existing persona/conversation behavior.
dependency-sovereignty completion requires an authoritative inventory, classifications, savant-owned seams for strategically important replaceable semantics, and provenance-bearing collision-safe proprietary replacements where replacement is justified.
source-derived context
the current project sources establish that niche task graph authority outranks projected markdown, that palaver owns conversation, envoy owns persona/voice intent, and opus owns external api orchestration. historical source material also documents earlier computational-soul concepts and prior external dependencies/fallbacks; those are evidence and lineage, not automatic current authority.

from __future__ import annotations

import re


PRIVATE_KEY = re.compile(
    r"-----BEGIN [A-Z0-9 ]*PRIVATE KEY-----.*?-----END [A-Z0-9 ]*PRIVATE KEY-----",
    re.DOTALL,
)
AWS_ACCESS_KEY = re.compile(r"\b(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}\b")
JWT = re.compile(r"\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\b")
ASSIGNMENT = re.compile(
    r"(?im)^(?P<prefix>\s*(?:export\s+)?(?:api[_-]?key|secret(?:[_-]?key)?|token|password|passwd|aws_access_key_id|aws_secret_access_key|github_token|openai_api_key|anthropic_api_key)\s*[:=]\s*)(?P<quote>['\"]?)(?P<value>[^\s'\"#]+)(?P=quote)"
)
URL_CREDENTIAL = re.compile(r"(?P<scheme>https?://)(?P<user>[^/@:\s]+):(?P<password>[^/@\s]+)@")


def redact_text(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
    count = 0

    def replace_private(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        nonlocal count
        count += 1
        header = match.group(0).splitlines()[0]
        return f"{header}\n[REDACTED PRIVATE KEY]\n-----END REDACTED PRIVATE KEY-----"

    text = PRIVATE_KEY.sub(replace_private, text)

    def simple(pattern: re.Pattern[str], replacement: str, value: str) -> str:
        nonlocal count
        value, substitutions = pattern.subn(replacement, value)
        count += substitutions
        return value

    text = simple(AWS_ACCESS_KEY, "[REDACTED AWS ACCESS KEY]", text)
    text = simple(JWT, "[REDACTED JWT]", text)

    def replace_assignment(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        nonlocal count
        count += 1
        quote = match.group("quote")
        return f"{match.group('prefix')}{quote}[REDACTED]{quote}"

    text = ASSIGNMENT.sub(replace_assignment, text)

    def replace_url(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        nonlocal count
        count += 1
        return f"{match.group('scheme')}[REDACTED]:[REDACTED]@"

    text = URL_CREDENTIAL.sub(replace_url, text)
    return text, count
